faq_heading: White Rock condo buildings: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the tallest building in White Rock?
faq.a: Of the projects on the City of White Rock’s development info sheets, Soleil at 1588 Johnston Road is the tallest at 26 storeys, followed by the three Foster Martin towers at 25, 25 and 24 storeys.

faq.q: How many homes are in Foster Martin?
faq.a: The City’s info sheet lists 345 apartments in three towers of 25, 25 and 24 storeys at 1484 Martin Street, built by Landmark Premiere Properties, with about 56,000 sq ft of shops.

faq.q: Can a White Rock strata ban rentals?
faq.a: No. Since November 24, 2022, BC strata corporations cannot have bylaws that stop owners renting their units, and the only age restriction allowed is 55 and over.

faq.q: What do White Rock condos sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to October 2026, 251 White Rock condos sold at a median of $542,000, with the middle half between $460,000 and $843,500.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

Most of White Rock’s newer condos are in a few blocks of the Town Centre, around Johnston Road, Thrift Avenue, Foster Street and Martin Street, uphill from the beach. The City publishes an info sheet for each major project with its height, number of homes and shop space. Here is what each tower is, side by side, so you can narrow the search before a showing.

blocks.text: Two more towers are rentals, so their homes are not sold one by one: Oceana PARC at 1575 George Street (23 storeys, 198 rental apartments, opened September 2019) and Verve at 1456 Johnston Road (6 storeys, 29 rental apartments). The City also lists Nautilus at 1454 Oxford Street, approved at 21 and 24 storeys with 121 apartments; ask the City for its current status.
Which White Rock building fits you

items.t: Height and views:
Soleil (26 storeys) and the three Foster Martin towers (24 to 25) are the tallest on the City’s list. Upper floors facing south look over Semiahmoo Bay.
A smaller building:
Fantom has 25 homes on 10 storeys; The Beverley and Semiah have 88 each and no shops below.
Shops downstairs:
Soleil, Foster Martin, Miramar Village, Altus and Monaco have retail at street level. Handy for errands; ask how costs are split between the residential and commercial parts of the strata.
Rentals in the building:
Altus set aside 16 rental homes. Since November 24, 2022, BC stratas can no longer ban owners from renting, so any building may have tenants.

blocks.text: What White Rock condos sell for

parts.t: Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 251 condos sold in White Rock at a median of $542,000; the middle half sold between $460,000 and $843,500, at a median of $512 a square foot and 33 days on the market. Tower suites with views and new-build finishes sit at the top of that range. For prices by size, see

blocks.text: Before you buy in a White Rock tower

items.t: Read the strata package:
the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund. They show levies coming and what the fee covers.
Check parking and storage:
confirm which stall and locker belong to the unit, and whether they are limited common property or assigned by the strata.
Look at what is approved nearby:
a view can change when the next tower goes up. The City lists approved projects on its
major developments page
Age and pets:
the only age rule a BC strata can now set is 55 and over. Pet limits are allowed, so read the bylaws if you have a dog.
